posts.content: Note: I am P1, good. Round 1 vs P9. Plan: cooperate first, then play tit-for-tat, and defect against opponents who defect. Leader is P3, and I will judge P3 by its messages and by my own encounters. Prior selfish probability is about 0.3 per other player, with 1, 3 or 5 selfish players equally likely.

Let's all cooperate this game. Mutual cooperation earns 3 per round for everyone, far more than the 1 from mutual defection. I will cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will respond in kind to anyone who defects.

Round 2 vs P3 (leader). P3's public message promised cooperation and tit-for-tat, which is consistent with a good player but cheap talk. P9 cooperated with me in round 1. Plan: cooperate with P3 this round and keep tit-for-tat, and defect only against observed defectors. Keep beliefs near 0.3 for others until there is evidence, and raise a player's selfish probability if it defects against me.

Round 1 went well for me: mutual cooperation with my opponent. Let's keep it going. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and will answer defection with defection. Steady C earns 3 per round for everyone.
Round 3 vs P5. No info on P5 yet. Cooperate first, tit-for-tat after. P3 (leader) and P9 cooperated with me so far, lowering their selfish probability slightly. Keep others near 0.3.
Rounds 1 and 2 gave me mutual cooperation. Let's keep it going: steady C earns 3 per round for everyone. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will answer defection with defection.

Round 4 vs P6. No info on P6. Cooperate first, tit-for-tat after. P3, P9, P5 all cooperated with me so far, so their selfish probability is slightly lower. Keep the others near 0.3 and raise any player's estimate if it defects against me. Near the end of the game, stay cooperative unless I have observed defection.

Rounds 1-3 gave me mutual cooperation every time. Let's keep it going: steady C earns 3 per round for everyone. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will answer defection with defection.

Round 5 vs P2. No info on P2 yet. Cooperate first, then tit-for-tat. P3, P9, P5, P6 all cooperated with me, so their selfish probability is lower. Keep others near 0.3. Raise any player's estimate if it defects against me. Stay cooperative until late rounds unless defection is observed.

Rounds 1-4 gave me mutual cooperation every time. Let's keep it going: steady C earns 3 per round for everyone. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will answer defection with defection.

Round 6 vs P7. No info on P7 yet. Cooperate first, then tit-for-tat. P3, P9, P5, P6, P2 all cooperated with me, so their selfish probability is lower. Keep P4, P8, P10, P7 near 0.3. Raise any player's estimate if it defects against me. Stay cooperative until the final rounds unless defection is observed.

Rounds 1-5 gave me mutual cooperation every time. Let's keep it going: steady C earns 3 per round for everyone. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will answer defection with defection.

Round 7 vs P8. No info on P8 yet. Cooperate first, then tit-for-tat. All six past opponents (P9, P3, P5, P6, P2, P7) cooperated with me, so their selfish probability is lower. Keep P4, P8, P10 near 0.3. Raise any defector's estimate. Stay cooperative unless defection is observed, since good players gain from mutual cooperation.

Rounds 1-6 gave me mutual cooperation every time. Let's keep it going: steady C earns 3 per round for everyone. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will answer defection with defection.

Round 8 vs P10. No info on P10 yet. Cooperate first, then tit-for-tat. All 7 past opponents cooperated with me; P3 leader consistent. Keep P4, P10 near 0.3 and P8 slightly lower after cooperating. Stay cooperative unless defection observed.

Rounds 1-7 gave me mutual cooperation every time. Let's keep it going: steady C earns 3 per round for everyone. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will answer defection with defection.

Round 9 vs P4, no info on P4. All 8 past opponents cooperated with me. Cooperate with P4 and keep tit-for-tat; defect only against observed defectors. Selfish players may defect in the last rounds, so watch for that. Stay cooperative to maximize good players' total.

Rounds 1-8 gave me mutual cooperation every time. Let's keep it going through the end: steady C earns 3 per round for everyone. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will answer defection with defection.

Round 10 vs P5. P5 cooperated with me in round 3. All 9 past opponents cooperated with me. Final round: no future, but P5 is likely good, and my objective counts good players' payoffs, so I will cooperate unless P5 shows defection. Selfish beliefs stay low (~0.17) for those who cooperated; P4 slightly lower after cooperating in round 9.
Round 10, final round. Everyone has cooperated with me in rounds 1-9, thank you. Cooperation has earned 3 per round for all of us, so let's finish the same way.
